Name: (AT) Purple Plant Pots
Author: prerona2411
Description:
[size=4][b]DO YOU LIKE [color=#c27ba0]PURPLE[/color]? THEN THIS MOD MAY BE FOR YOU!

[/b][/size]What? You don't like purple? Well, hopefully you'll still consider this mod if you like decorating!

This mod has a few purple and violet retextures and redesigns of the craftable Garden Pot. It's something I came up with randomly and made, to take a little break from my main mod.

[b]INSTRUCTIONS
[/b]1) Install Alternative Textures
2) Buy the Paint Bucket from Robin
3) Use it on the Garden Pot

I might add a few more designs over time, but for now there are 10 retextures available in this mod. Happy Decorating!

[b]MODS USED IN PREVIEW
[/b]- My own mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16521]Genshin Valley[/url]
- Doragoun's really cool [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17069]Digimon FS Outfits[/url]!
- Wildflour and cometkins' pretty [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15452]Witchy Furniture[/url], and
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12425]Divine Decor[/url]!
